integrity: Exact distribution is proved by a colour-class dichotomy and a linear-extension recurrence. Exhaustive finite checks support, but do not prove, the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly random vertex orders on labelled crown graphs \(K_{n,n}\) minus a fixed perfect matching, n at least two.
Applies to irrevocable unbuffered smallest-admissible-colour FirstFit, not arbitrary online colouring algorithms or graph distributions.
Exact distribution and general proof receive self-review only; independent audit and exhaustive historical-priority review are outstanding.
title: The exact random-order FirstFit colour law on crown graphs
